name: m8-01-1
title: What BCM is, in simple words
spec:
flowchart TD subgraph HEAD["Head node (or an HA pair)"] CMD["CMDaemon
the central service"] DB["Database
holds all configuration"] IMG["Software images
/cm/images"] SVC["Services: DHCP, TFTP and HTTP boot,
provisioning, DNS, NTP, LDAP"] end CMSH["cmsh
shell front end"] --> CMD BV["Base View
web front end"] --> CMD CMD --- DB CMD --- IMG SVC -->|"network boot"| NODE subgraph NODES["Regular nodes"] NODE["node-installer at boot"] ND["CMDaemon on each node
monitoring and configuration"] end CMD <--> ND BMC["BMCs, PDUs, switches"] -. "power and hardware control" .-> CMD

name: m8-01-2
title: The object model
spec:
flowchart LR DEV["Device
a node, switch, PDU, GPU unit ..."] CAT["Category
a group of regular nodes
that share configuration"] IMG["Software image
a directory on the head node
used as the node's root filesystem"] ROLE["Role
a task a node can perform"] OV["Configuration overlay
roles with a priority,
for chosen nodes"] GRP["Node group
any set of nodes
(operations only)"] PART["Partition
the base object:
defaultcategory ..."] DEV -->|"is in exactly one"| CAT CAT -->|"uses"| IMG CAT -->|"can hold"| ROLE DEV -->|"can hold"| ROLE OV -->|"assigns"| ROLE OV -->|"to"| DEV OV -->|"or to"| CAT GRP -.->|"contains"| DEV PART -->|"names the default"| CAT

name: m8-02-1
title: What you are installing
spec:
flowchart LR
  P[Plan: hardware, network, names, disk, license] --> H[Install head node]
  H --> C[First boot checks]
  C --> N[Boot regular nodes from the network]
  N --> I[Identify nodes: assign names to MAC addresses]
  I --> B[Burn-in test]
  B --> W[Workload manager and users]

name: m8-02-2
title: The three network topologies
spec:
flowchart TB
  subgraph T1[Type 1: private internal network, the default]
    direction LR
    N1[nodes] --- I1[internalnet] --- H1[head node] --- E1[externalnet / corporate]
  end
  subgraph T2[Type 2: nodes behind a router on a public network]
    direction LR
    N2[nodes] --- R2[router] --- P2[public network]
    N2 --- H2[head node, same network as nodes]
  end
  subgraph T3[Type 3: head node and nodes on different routed networks]
    direction LR
    N3[nodes: internalnet] --- R3[routers] --- H3[head node: managementnet]
  end

name: m8-03-1
title: The shape of it: partition, overlay, category, node
spec:
flowchart TB
  P[partition: cluster-wide default] --> C[category: for a kind of node]
  C --> N[node: for one machine]
  N --> V[the value the node really gets]
  P -.->|used if nothing below sets it| V

name: m8-04-1
title: The big picture
spec:
flowchart LR
  A[Power on] --> B[PXE: DHCP + boot loader]
  B --> C[Kernel + ramdisk]
  C --> D[Node installer: 13 steps]
  D --> E[Image copied to disk]
  E --> F[Hand over to local init]
  F --> G[CMDaemon connects: UP]

name: m8-04-2
title: The node installer: 13 steps (5.4)
spec:
flowchart TB
  S1[1 request a node certificate] --> S2[2 decide node configuration]
  S2 --> S3[3 bring up network interfaces]
  S3 --> S4[4 decide install mode]
  S4 --> S5[5 initialize script]
  S5 --> S6[6 check partitions, mount]
  S6 --> S7[7 sync disk with the image]
  S7 --> S8[8 write network config files]
  S8 --> S9[9 write fstab]
  S9 --> S10[10 boot record and SELinux]
  S10 --> S11[11 finalize script]
  S11 --> S12[12 unload drivers]
  S12 --> S13[13 switch to local init]

name: m8-04-3
title: Node states (5.5)
spec:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> DOWN
  DOWN --> BOOTING: power on
  BOOTING --> INSTALLING
  INSTALLING --> INSTALLER_CALLINGINIT: handover
  INSTALLER_CALLINGINIT --> UP: CMDaemon connects
  UP --> DOWN: CMDaemon lost
  INSTALLING --> INSTALLER_FAILED: unrecoverable problem
  INSTALLING --> INSTALLER_UNREACHABLE: pings lost
  INSTALLING --> INSTALLER_REBOOTING: kernel reboot
  INSTALLER_REBOOTING --> INSTALLER_FAILED: too slow
  INSTALLER_CALLINGINIT --> INSTALLER_FAILED: too slow

name: m8-05-1
title: Two front ends, one daemon
spec:
flowchart LR
  BV[Base View: browser, port 8081 /base-view] --> D[CMDaemon on the head node]
  C[cmsh: shell on the head node] --> D
  D --> DB[(MySQL database)]
  D --> N[CMDaemon on each regular node]

name: m8-06-1
title: The big picture
spec:
flowchart LR
  U[Person with a certificate] --> F[cmsh or Base View]
  F -->|TLS 8081 + certificate with profile| D[CMDaemon]
  D --> T{profile has the token?}
  T -->|yes| A[action runs]
  T -->|no| X[refused]
  D --> L[(LDAP: cluster users and groups)]
  S[Users logging in to nodes] --> L

name: m8-07-1
title: BMC networks and credentials (3.7)
spec:
flowchart LR
  H[head node: alias or interface on BMC network] --- N[bmcnet 10.148.0.0/16]
  N --- B1[node001 BMC ipmi0 10.148.0.1]
  N --- B2[node002 BMC ipmi0 10.148.0.2]
  NI[node installer] -->|configures at boot| B1
  CM[CMDaemon] -->|power, sensors, firmware| B1

name: m8-07-2
title: BIOS settings: four states (14.5.2)
spec:
flowchart LR
  A[cmsh or Base View: set] -->|commit| B[CMDaemon database: Configured]
  B -->|bios apply| C[BIOS: Pending]
  C -->|reboot| D[BIOS: Live]

name: m8-08-1
title: The GPU overlay trap
spec:
flowchart LR
  A[node in overlay slurm-client: 500] --> W{highest priority wins}
  B[same node in overlay slurm-client-gpu: 450] --> W
  W --> R[plain client role: no GPU settings]

name: m8-09-1
title: The reference architecture (4.1)
spec:
flowchart TB
  subgraph H["head node(s)"]
    NG[NGINX: API server proxy 10443 + Gateway proxy 443]
  end
  subgraph E[etcd nodes: odd number, 3 recommended]
    E1[etcd]
    E2[etcd]
    E3[etcd]
  end
  subgraph C[control plane nodes: 2 or 3]
    C1[kube-apiserver, scheduler, controller manager, CoreDNS]
    C2[...]
  end
  subgraph W[worker nodes: user workloads]
    W1[kubelet + containerd + GPUs]
  end
  NG --> C1
  NG --> C2
  C1 --> E1
  W1 --> NG

name: m8-09-2
title: Getting traffic in: the Gateway (4.17)
spec:
flowchart LR
  U[external client] -->|443, TLS SNI| P[Gateway proxy: NGINX on head node]
  P --> G[Gateway bcm-gateway: MetalLB IP]
  G --> K[Kgateway proxy pods]
  K --> S[services: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, landing page...]

name: m8-10-1
title: The four tools side by side
spec:
flowchart TB
  Q{what are you running?}
  Q -->|batch jobs under Slurm| EP[Enroot + Pyxis: integrated by BCM]
  Q -->|long-running services| K[Kubernetes with containerd]
  Q -->|admin tasks, registry hosts| D[Docker: root on the host]
  Q -->|HPC jobs, existing .sif workflow| A[Apptainer: you support it]

name: m8-11-1
title: The pipeline
spec:
flowchart LR
  P[data producer: a sampler or a script] -->|every N seconds| M[measurable: metric, enummetric or health check]
  M --> S[(stored on the node, picked up by the head node)]
  M --> T{trigger: expression on a measurable}
  T -->|enter, leave, during, flapping| A[action: built-in or script]
  M -->|severity| L[AlertLevel metrics]
  A --> E[event + mail + drain + power ...]

name: m8-12-1
title: The pair
spec:
flowchart TB
  subgraph NET[shared network identity]
    VI[shared internal IP: alias eth0:0]
    VE[shared external IP: alias eth1:0]
  end
  subgraph A[head A: ACTIVE]
    A1[CMDaemon, MySQL master]
    A2[NFS export, user portal, slurmdbd]
  end
  subgraph B[head B: PASSIVE]
    B1[CMDaemon, MySQL replica]
    B2[services on standby]
  end
  NAS[(NAS / NFS: /home and /cm/shared)]
  HB[failover network: direct cable]
  PW[power control of each head: BMC or PDU]
  VI --- A
  VE --- A
  A <-->|heartbeat| HB
  B <-->|heartbeat| HB
  A --- NAS
  B -.->|mounts only after becoming active| NAS
  B -->|power off A if proven dead| PW

name: m8-13-1
title: Change runbooks (my assembly)
spec:
flowchart LR BACKUP["1. Pre-Change Backup
cmdaemon-backup before-change
+ clone/lock software image"] --> CANARY["2. Canary Test (1 Node)
chroot edit -> updateprovisioners
-> imageupdate dry-run & synclog -> -w"] CANARY --> WAVE["3. Rolling Rack Waves
drain -> apply/reboot -> health check
-> undrain (Active head first for HA)"] WAVE --> VERIFY["4. Post-Change Verification
cmha status, hardware-profile,
sinfo / kubectl get nodes"] WAVE -. "regression detected" .-> ROLLBACK["Rollback Path
setparent / previous image
or cmha dbreclone / sql.gz"]

name: m8-14-1
title: The reference scenario
spec:
flowchart LR
  subgraph I[initial host: internet]
    D[download scripts] --> T[airgapped.tgz]
  end
  T -->|USB / transfer| H[active head node]
  subgraph C[air-gapped cluster]
    H --> R[local registry master.cm.cluster:5000]

  end

name: m8-15-1
title: The four networks
spec:
flowchart TB
  subgraph T[compute tray]
    CX[4 x ConnectX-8, 800 Gb/s each]
    BF[BlueField-3: 2 x 400 Gb/s]
    BMC[BMC and BlueField BMC]
  end
  CX --> IB[compute fabric: Quantum-X800 InfiniBand, rail-optimized full fat tree]
  BF -->|400 Gb/s| ST[storage fabric: Spectrum-4 SN5600, RoCEv2]
  BF -->|at least 200 Gb/s| IN[in-band network: Ethernet]
  BMC --> OOB[out-of-band: SN2201, 48 x 1 Gb/s]
  IN --> EDGE[customer edge: 2 x 100GbE, eBGP]

name: m8-16-1
title: The Mission Control software stack on a DGX SuperPOD
spec:
flowchart TB subgraph MC["NVIDIA Mission Control: five roles in the software stack"] direction LR A["System health & diagnostics
(foundational health base)"] B["Telemetry & Observability
(diagnostic tools & health checks)"] C["Validation & Diagnostics
(autonomous recovery engine)"] D["Cluster management
(BCM + NMX Manager)"] E["Workload orchestration
(Slurm & Kubernetes + Run:ai)"] end

name: m8-16-2
title: Head-node HA and databases that are not replicated by default
spec:
flowchart LR DB["Databases on primary head:
cmdaemon, slurm_acct_db, third-party DB (e.g. AJR), mysql, sys"] --> Q{"BCM 11.34+ with
--replicate-all-databases
or DB listed in extradbclone.xml?"} Q -->|No: default HA| D1["Passive head gets:
cmdaemon, slurm_acct_db
(third-party DB is MISSING after failover)"] Q -->|Yes| D2["Passive head gets:
cmdaemon, slurm_acct_db, third-party DB
(system schemas mysql, sys never replicated)"]

name: m8-16-3
title: How the setup wizard changed in BCM 11.33
spec:
flowchart TB subgraph PRE["Prior to BCM 11.33 (single wizard)"] K1["cm-kubernetes-setup:
select Run:ai (SaaS or self-hosted) + enter credentials"] end subgraph POST["From BCM 11.33 onwards (decoupled into two steps)"] direction LR K2["Step 1: cm-kubernetes-setup
(deploy Kubernetes + dependency operators)"] --> R2["Step 2: cm-runai-setup
(requires cm-setup-runai-bcm11 plugin)"] end
